tools.name: get_smart_tokens
tools.description: Tokens that smart wallets (a track record of early 2x calls) and insiders (linked to a dev) bought within a window, most wallets first, with how many still hold and the move since the first smart buy.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: One token: live market (mcap, change, volume, holders), the smart wallets and insiders in it, its launch (dev bundle, same-block buys, snipers; bots left out) and its earliest wallets.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: One wallet: skill, early calls, holding habits, insider evidence and its trades of the last 7 days.

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Live alerts, newest first: insider and smart buys and sells, launches, bundle and dev sells, clusters. Pass after_id (the largest id you have) to get only new ones.

tools.name: get_launches
tools.description: Recent launches on every launchpad with dev bundle, insiders' share, snipers and smart buys. signals_only (default) keeps the last 24 hours' launches that have any of these.

tools.name: get_top_wallets
tools.description: Wallets ranked: smart (by skill), insiders (by evidence), all, or sniper bots.

tools.name: get_launchpads
tools.description: Every Elysium launchpad compared: 24h volume and trades, launches today and this week, tokens in all, tokens over $100K and the share of dev-bundled launches, with each one's top tokens.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Chain news from on-chain events: market cap milestones, new launchpads, insider clusters, large dev sells, heavily bundled launches and the daily recap.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Find tokens by symbol prefix (case-insensitive), largest market cap first.

tools.name: build_buy_tx
tools.description: Build a Montra buy (HYPE -> token) for your wallet: one transaction with nonce, fees and gas filled, plus the quote and the minimum you will accept. Elytrack's fee (elytrack_fee_pct of amount_hype, shown in the answer) is paid out of amount_hype in the same transaction. Sign it yourself; Elytrack ho

tools.name: build_sell_tx
tools.description: Build a Montra sale (token -> HYPE) for your wallet: an approve for the router when needed, then the swap. Sign them yourself and send them in order.

tools.name: send_signed_tx
tools.description: Send a transaction you signed into Elysium through the Montra RPC. Returns its hash; check it with get_tx_status. At most 10 a minute per client.

tools.name: get_tx_status
tools.description: Where a sent transaction is: queued, posted to the inbox, landed (with block and success) or dropped.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feed, get_tx_status · Private data: get_smart_tokens, get_token, get_wallet, get_launchpads, search_tokens, build_buy_tx, build_sell_tx · Public sink: get_launches, get_launchpads, build_sell_tx, send_signed_tx.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feed, get_tx_status · Private data: get_smart_tokens, get_token, get_wallet, get_launchpads, search_tokens, build_buy_tx, build_sell_tx · Public sink: get_launches, get_launchpads, build_sell_tx, send_signed_tx

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
